name: Orb Of Light Lesser
body:
School illumination (conjuration) (creation); Level shadowsworn 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

EFFECT

Effect one orb of light

DESCRIPTION

A smallish orb of pure light shoots from your fingertips at a target. If you succeed on a ranged touch attack, the orb causes 1d8 hp damage. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you inflict an additional 1d8 hp damage; 2d8 at 3rd level, 3d8 at 5th, and so on, to the maximum of 5d8 at 9th level or higher.
